title: Saturn's Frozen Moon Fires Water Jets at 800 mph

scenes.text: A frozen moon fires water into space.
It's Enceladus, a small moon of Saturn.
Cracks near its south pole spray vapor and ice hundreds of miles into space.
The jets blast out at about eight hundred miles an hour.
NASA's Cassini spacecraft flew right through the spray.
Scientists think it comes from an ocean hidden under the ice.
